judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation after completing only the first two facets of its plan, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and an extra `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file in the worktree. While `ToolRegistry.execute` implements basic `ajv` validation, it lacks the required one-line doc comment, does not emit a warning log on validation failure, compiles function-valued definitions eagerly at `register` time, and only caches a single `cachedSchema` reference per tool rather than using a `WeakMap` across schema objects. Nearly all required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (which has only 1 test instead of the 7 required) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (untouched) are missing, along with their spec links in `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
